# Quality assurance rule set (D2)

**Generated by `build_qa_rules_doc.py` from the store this run produced.**
Counts are queried, not transcribed. Rule definitions come from the same
`RULES` table `stage02_qa.py` applies, so this document cannot describe a
rule the pipeline does not run.

**Rules flag; they do not delete.** Every point read is stored and every
stored point carries a quality decision. *Exclude* means excluded from
coverage attribution, not removed from the store - the pack asks for this
twice, and it is what makes a threshold reversible.

| Rule | Disposition | Threshold | Points | Source of the threshold |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| QA01 outside campaign window | exclude | 9-13 March 2026 | 633,207 | D-004a - the campaign window stated in the pack |
| QA02 outside duty hours | exclude | 07:00-16:59 | 514,752 | D-004b - measured from the activity plateau, not assumed |
| QA03 reported speed > 15 km/h | exclude | 15 km/h reported | 4,568 | D-004c - speed is bimodal; any cut from 6 to 120 km/h flags the same 1,437 points |
| QA04 implied speed > 15 km/h | exclude | 15 km/h implied | 1,560 | D-004c - the same threshold applied to position-derived speed |
| QA04 implied speed unevaluable | note | 15 km/h implied | 798,134 | D-004c - the same threshold applied to position-derived speed |
| QA05 degraded accuracy tier | flag only | no exclusion | 515,208 | D-004d - a fixed cut removes 62% of eight teams' tracks and manufactures a coverage finding from an equipment property |
| QA06 minute in dispute | flag only | same team, same minute, different position | 798,102 | D-002 - the collision is the thing in dispute, so it is flagged, never resolved silently |
| QA07 gap > 5 min | flag only | 5 min interruption, 15 min outage | 219 | D-004e - counts barely move across a 3x change, so the finding is insensitive to the cut |
| QA07 gap > 15 min | flag only | 5 min interruption, 15 min outage | 173 | D-004e - counts barely move across a 3x change, so the finding is insensitive to the cut |
| QA08a null island (0,0) | exclude | outside the operational envelope | 71 | D-008 - null island excluded, transposition corrected only where corroborated within 500 m |
| QA08b transposed, corrected | correct | outside the operational envelope | 198 | D-008 - null island excluded, transposition corrected only where corroborated within 500 m |
| QA08b transposed, uncorrob. | exclude | outside the operational envelope | 1 | D-008 - null island excluded, transposition corrected only where corroborated within 500 m |
| QA08c outside operational area | exclude | outside the operational envelope | 501 | D-008 - null island excluded, transposition corrected only where corroborated within 500 m |
| QA09 stationary cluster >= 5 min | flag only | 5 minutes stationary | 2,062 | D-004g - the same definition as a visit, so it marks the signal as much as a defect |

## Reconciliation

| | |
|---|---:|
| Points in the store | 929,733 |
| Points carrying a quality decision | 929,733 |
| **Usable for coverage attribution** | **150,940** (16.2%) |

Counts sum to more than the store because a point can fail several rules -
a fix outside the campaign window is usually outside duty hours too. The
reconciliation that matters is the last line: **every stored point has a
quality decision**, asserted by `stage02_qa.py` and tested by
`tests/test_store.py`.

## The five the question names

| Required | Implemented as |
|---|---|
| Implausible speeds | QA03 and QA04 - the logger's claim and the position-derived value are different assertions, so they are separate rules |
| Positional accuracy thresholds | QA05 - addressed and **deliberately excludes nothing**; accuracy scales the attribution tolerance instead (D-005) |
| Points outside campaign duty hours | QA02 |
| Gaps in the fix sequence | QA07, at two severities |
| Stationary clusters | QA09 |

QA01, QA06 and QA08 are additional: the campaign window, the colliding-key
conflict that 63% of the store carries, and coordinates that are
geographically impossible.
